text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor a-l-l-o-w-e-d the i-m-p-o-r-t-e-d s-t-o-c-k to f-a-i-l a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y and t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n and then r-e-l-a-b-e-l-e-d the p-a-c-k-a-g-i-n-g to f-a-l-s-i-f-y the o-r-i-g-i-n while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the o-f-f-i-c-i-a-l q-u-a-l-i-t-y c-o-n-t-r-o-l r-e-p-o-r-t.
2) the actor r-e-w-r-o-t-e the c-o-l-d c-h-a-i-n l-o-g-s and s-e-r-i-a-l-i-z-a-t-i-o-n n-u-m-b-e-r-s on the d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e to m-a-s-k the t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e b-r-e-a-c-h and t-h-e u-n-a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-e-d h-a-n-d-l-i-n-g while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-m-m-u-t-a-b-l-e a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l c-h-e-c-k.
3) the actor d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-e-d the d-o-c-t-o-r-e-d m-e-d-i-c-i-n-e t-h-r-o-u-g-h r-e-t-a-i-l p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y n-e-t-w-o-r-k-s u-s-i-n-g a l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e l-i-c-e-n-s-e to b-y-p-a-s-e s-c-r-u-t-i-n-y and p-l-a-c-e the p-r-o-d-u-c-t in the h-a-n-d-s of p-a-t-i-e-n-t-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-r-u-g v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l.
4) the actor m-o-n-i-t-o-r-e-d r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y a-n-d m-e-d-i-a c-h-a-n-n-e-l-s to t-r-a-c-k the s-e-a-r-c-h for a-n-y a-n-o-m-a-l-y in the m-a-r-k-e-t p-l-a-c-e-m-e-n-t and a-d-j-u-s-t e-d the l-o-g-g-i-n-g t-i-m-e-s t-a-m-p-s to a-v-o-i-d d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-t-e-r-n-a-l i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y a-s-s-e-s-s-m-e-n-t.
5) the actor a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d the r-e-c-o-r-d-s of the i-l-l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y i-n-to a s-h-e-l-l f-o-l-d-e-r to c-l-e-a-r the i-m-m-e-d-i-a-t-e t-r-a-c-e and p-r-e-s-e-r-v-e the c-h-a-i-n of c-u-s-t-o-d-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-e-g-a-l c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e r-e-v-i-e-w and d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t r-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t-s.
